messages:
Jordan Lee: Hi payroll team — my March 115 paycheck withheld CA state tax but I moved to OR on 2026-03-05. I updated Rippling and submitted the relocation doc yesterday. Can we prorate state withholding so CA covers March 1-5 only? Payroll ref: PR-6621.

People Ops: Thanks Jordan. We need proof of move (lease or change-of-address confirmation) and the relocation form. @Samir can you check the effective date on file?

Samir Patel: I see relocation effective 2026-03-05 in Rippling but no supporting lease uploaded. Also note OR has no state income tax. If you were physically in CA through 3/5 we can split the run pro rata. Which pay period is this?

Jordan Lee: Pay period is Mar 115. I left CA midday 3/5. I'll drop a scanned lease and USPS change-of-address confirmation to payroll@redwood.com now.

Payroll Bot: Adjustment ticket created: ADJ-TKT-8745 for PR-6621. Please attach docs to the ticket. Choose refund method: "next-regular" or "off-cycle".

Jordan Lee: Next-regular please. Thanks.

Benefits Team: FYI, moving states may affect commuter benefits and CA disability withholding. @People Ops will coordinate with payroll on any other deductions to be prorated.

People Ops: Noted. For this run we'll prorate CA taxable wages for Mar 1-5 (5 days) and OR portion Mar 615 (10 days). CA SDI/State Disability will be prorated similarly; OR has no SDI. We'll issue a paystub annotation: "State Allocation Adjustment - CA" and a memo in the payroll portal.

Payroll Bot: ADJ-TKT-8745 processed. Adjustment record: ADJ-2026-03-87. CA withholding reduced by $198.45. Refund will appear on next paycheck dated 2026-03-31.

Jordan Lee: Confirmed receipt of updated stub in portal. Line item: "State Allocation Adjustment - CA" for $198.45. All good. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :raised_hands:

People Ops: Great, closing ticket. We'll monitor year-end totals and flag if a W-2 or W-2C is needed. If you'd like an earlier reconciliation, reply here and we can trigger a mid-year review.

Code snippet:
```
Payroll refs:
PR-6621
ADJ-TKT-8745
ADJ-2026-03-87
```
